description: This file defines an SCSS mixin named 'alert-variant' that sets CSS variables for alert components, including background, border, and text colors, and adjusts styles for alert links. It is part of a styling system for alerts within a larger project.

methods.name: alert-variant
methods.description: A mixin that applies alert-related styles, setting CSS variables for color, background, border, and link color, and optionally adding a gradient background if enabled.
